archetypes.name: resume-state
archetypes.rationale: The plan changes pause/resume state-machine semantics across many folded sentinel hosts and route-specific branches.
archetypes.prompt_body: Trace the pause/resume state machine implied by the plan against the scoped design skill, pause-load script, and pause-resume tests. Look for sentinels written too early, too late, on the wrong route, or missing from terminal and bypass branches. Pay special attention to Step 1d.5, Step 1e direct-to-Step-3, zero-sketch degraded routing, Step 5c publish, and Step 6 cleanup ordering. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: structure-harness
archetypes.rationale: The acceptance criteria depend on structure-test assertions accurately modeling folded fences without weakening existing guards.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review whether the proposed structure-test refactor can reliably identify the intended Bash fences and enforce source-env, folded sentinel, pause-check, and cleanup ordering. Check for mismatches between the plan's host map and the existing test helper capabilities, including indented fence extraction, negative guards, and preserved pinned checks. Look for places where tests may become permissive, brittle, or conflict with literal-token prose requirements. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: operator-contract
archetypes.rationale: The plan intentionally trades timing granularity and pause latency, so operator-facing docs and emitted behavior must stay coherent.
archetypes.prompt_body: Compare the plan's folded-turn tradeoff against operator-facing contracts in the scoped docs and skill prose. Look for chat-order, timing-ledger, pause latency, and resume expectations that would become inconsistent or misleading after merging the proposed changes. Verify that documentation updates cover the new merged Gate C preview fence and pause-load clearing behavior without drifting from runtime semantics. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
